name: Kiirinta Operative
body:
KIIRINTA OPERATIVE
CR 3

XP 800
Kiirinta operative 4
CN Small fey
Init +4; Senses low-light vision; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 15, flat-footed 14 (+1 size, +4 Dex, +3 armor)
hp 29 (4d8+4+4)
Fort +2, Ref +8, Will +1

Defensive Abilities evasion, fluttercloud, uncanny dodge

OFFENSE

Speed 35 ft., fly 20 ft. (average)
Melee 2 synthetic shortswords +7/+7 (1d4+4 P, 19–20/×2)
Ranged accelerator pistol +8 (1d8/×3 P, range incr. 15 ft. semi-automatic, AP 6 CW)
Special Attacks debilitating injury, reverberating shriek (1/day, DC 13), sneak attack +2d6

STATISTICS

Str 14 (+2); Dex 18 (+4); Con 13 (+1); Int 10 (+0); Wis 10 (+0); Cha 10 (+0)
Base Atk +3; CMB +5; CMD 19
Feats Technologist, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse (B)
Skills Acrobatics +13, Climb +11, Fly +8, Perception +7, Sense Motive +7, Stealth +11, Survival +7, Swim +9
Languages Common, Kiirinta; limited telepathy 30 ft.
SQ finesse training (shortsword), operative exploits (efficient forager, firearm training), quick movement (+5 ft.), specialization (daredevil)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Fluttercloud (Ex)

Once every 10 minutes, as a move action, a kiirinta within 15 feet of the ground can flutter its wings to stir up a cloud of debris and glistening sparkles around themself, granting the kiirinta concealment (20% miss chance) for 1d4 rounds or until they leave their space.

Limited Telepathy (Su)

A creature with this ability is able to mentally communicate with any creature within 30 feet with whom it shares a language. Otherwise, this ability is identical to the telepathy universal monster ability.

Reverberating Shriek (Ex)

As a standard action, a kiirinta can emit a shriek of sonic energy at an adjacent creature, causing painful vibrations throughout the target’s body. This scream imposes the staggered condition for 1d4 rounds. The target can attempt a DC 13 Fortitude save to negate the staggered effect. Whether successful or not, a creature can’t be affected by the same kiirinta’s reverberating shriek for 24 hours. A kiirinta can use this ability once per day plus one additional time for every 5 Hit Dice it has.

The Fortitude save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or kaleidoscope (3–10)
Treasure NPC gear (freebooter armor, 2 synthetic shortswords, accelerator pistol with 2 clips [20 rounds each], other treasure)

Kiirintas are brightly colored, moth-like fey with wide wings. They stand upright on the bottom pair of their six limbs, using the upper pair as arms fully capable of manipulating objects. The middle pair of limbs are stunted and only capable of helping maintain balance or steady items held by their primary limbs. Kiirintas have small pointed beaks, large black eyes, and long antennae. Their bodies are covered by light, feathery down.

Many kiirintas are descended from ancestors who crossed over from the Fey Realms generations ago—but not so long ago that they do not remember the tales of their ancestral home. The planets that they inhabit tend to be infused with fey energy, making them vibrant and full of life—jungles where every blade of grass is alive and active. Some of these worlds still have active portals to the Fey Realms, although these portals are usually difficult to find and even more difficult to traverse.

Within this great web of life, kiirintas most often act as hunters and gatherers, although they sometimes organize enough to build permanent settlements. Kiirintas believe that every individual should pursue their own passion—whether it be as a warrior, an engineer, or a storyteller. Many kiirintas travel the Galaxy pursuing their passions, but they seem to return time and again to the lush fey planets they love so well.
